description: This file defines a mock class 'GstWebAudioPlayerMock' for the 'IGstWebAudioPlayer' interface, used in unit testing within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It includes mock method declarations for audio player functionalities such as setCaps, play, pause, setVolume, getVolume, writeBuffer, setEos, and getQueuedBytes.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstWebAudioPlayer interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: setCaps
methods.description: Mocks setting the audio capabilities with MIME type and configuration.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current volume level.

methods.name: getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the number of queued bytes.
